implementation: For implementation with students who will complete their study of the course in 2025 or beyond.
objectives: Investigate the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning.

course_structure.description: At least four QCAA-developed units of 55 hours each from which schools build their course of study. Schools select four units from the six unit options and decide their order of implementation; Units 1 and 2 are completed before Units 3 and 4, which are studied as a pair.

unit_options.title: Play and creativity
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning through the context of play and creativity, planning, implementing and evaluating play-based learning activities.

unit_options.title: Literacy and numeracy
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning through actively responsive play-based learning activities that support children's literacy and numeracy.

unit_options.title: Children's development
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning in the context of children's development, promoting development according to children's needs.

unit_options.title: Children's wellbeing
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning in the context of children's wellbeing, supporting individual needs through play-based learning activities.

unit_options.title: Indoor and outdoor environments
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning in the context of age-appropriate indoor and outdoor learning environments that support children's needs.

unit_options.title: The early childhood education and care sector
unit_options.description: Students explore the fundamentals and practices of early childhood learning in the context of the childcare industry and the policies and frameworks that guide education and care services.

assessment_model.units_1_and_2: Schools develop at least two but no more than four assessments, complete at least one assessment for each unit and assess each unit objective at least once.
assessment_model.units_3_and_4: Schools develop four assessment instruments in Units 3 and 4 using the assessment specifications and conditions in the syllabus, following each selected unit option's Investigation (X1) and Project (X2) play-based activity instrument pattern.
assessment_model.external_assessment: None. Applied senior syllabuses are internally assessed; results are reported as A-E judgements.
